name: TUI Bridge
description: Run any TUI/CLI process as the chat backend. Each conversation owns one long-lived PTY-spawned process; user messages are written to its stdin and screen output is streamed back as chat messages.

defaultMode.description: Default output mode for new sessions. txt strips ANSI and streams raw bytes; tui renders into an xterm-headless screen and emits a snapshot on settle.

settleIdleMs.description: Idle gap that marks the TUI's output as 'settled' and ready to send to chat.

settleMaxMs.description: Hard cap on how long we wait for output to settle before forcing a flush.

logDir.description: Override directory for per-session logs. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/tui-bridge/.

allowedCommands.description: If set, only these binary names (first arg of /tui start) may be spawned. Empty/unset means all binaries are allowed.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed Binaries
allowedCommands.help: Restrict which executables /tui start can launch. If empty, any binary on PATH is allowed.
